name: XPRS 1.12.0-beta.4
body:
Beta: test it before 1.12.0 goes to the stable channel and F-Droid.

## New
- App Creator works on a phone: bottom navigation with the wapp's name on top and one Save; code scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, files are chips, build output is folded; the Screens tab has a full-width canvas, an Add block sheet and properties underneath; the Text tab has language chips.
- Wapps can be built on the device, where there is no wasi-sdk: the Compiler add-on runs clang and wasm-ld on the app's own runtime. It is installed like any other wapp, and App Creator has an AI button that opens it when it is installed.
- Install a .wapp file someone passed on (Install 1.4.4: menu > Install a file...). A picked file keeps its name whatever extension the system picker gave it.
- Wapps can make full HTTP requests (`hal_http_request2`: headers, a byte body, a timeout) and are woken when the answer arrives.
- Archiver tops the menu, and each group has its own menu.

## Fixes
- Share works again.
- A wapp installed from another page shows in the launcher at once, with its functionalities registered.
- A wapp's chat and search hints are translated like its labels; the Screens canvas shows screen names as the wapp shows them.
- App Creator: the App tab's fields are back (a slider value read as text blanked the card) and scale with large text; the manifest's title and description are read and written in the current schema.
- Building a wapp on a device with an encrypted profile no longer fails with exit 1: the build runs in a plain scratch folder, and the step's own error output is kept.
- Wapp HTTP requests: PUT and DELETE are no longer sent as GET.
- Chat: a new group's callsign list has no end; prompts cycle without end and group callsigns never loop.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xprs-dev/app/compare/v1.12.0-beta.3...v1.12.0-beta.4
